title: Deteriorating 12-month relationship -- deferred even though the customer sounds fine right now

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Dan -- how can I help today?
Hi there, I just had a quick question about my statement, nothing urgent.
Sure, happy to help -- let me pull that up for you.
Great, thanks. While I'm on, do you have anything new for premium customers? I keep seeing ads.
Let me take a look at what might make sense for your account.
No rush at all, take your time.
I appreciate that. For now let's make sure everything on your statement looks right -- anything that stood out to you?
Not really, it all looked fine actually.
Good to hear. Thanks for calling, have a great day!
